Order No.6: Dated 17 August 2023 th I.A. No. 2360 of 2023
The instant interlocutory application has been filed for suspension of sentence wherein the conviction is under Section 4 of the POCSO Act along with section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. This Court on consideration of the testimony of PW-6, the Prosecutrix, has found that she has consistently supported the prosecution version.
She was thoroughly been cross-examined, but she remained consistent.
Her statement was recorded under section 164 of the CrPC, wherein also she supported the prosecution version.
The doctor has also opined the tear of fourchetle.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant however has submitted that the appellant has remained in custody for 9 years 01 month 20 days including the period of remission, custody period will be of 12 years, 2 months and 01 day, as per the custody report furnished by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor under the signature of the 2 Criminal Appeal (DB) No.1048 of 2015 Superintendent of Birsa Munda Central Jail, Hotwar, Ranchi dated 14.08.2023.

entities.text: Birsa Munda Central Jail, Hotwar, Ranchi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Let a copy of the letter dated 14.08.2023 be kept on record.

4. This court, taking into consideration the testimony of the prosecutrix, wherein she has supported the prosecution version and remain consistent in cross-examination as also the testimony of other Anukaran Kandulna vs The State Of Jharkhand on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157430374/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 witnesses, prime facie not satisfied that the case to be fit for suspension of sentence.
5. Accordingly, the I.A. No.2360 of 2023 is rejected.

6. However taking the fact into consideration that out of the maximum punishment of 20 years, the appellant has undergone the imprisonment of 9 years 01 months 20 days, therefore let the instant appeal be listed for final hearing.
7. The office is directed to furnish the paper book to the learned counsels for the parties.
8. Accordingly, list this instant appeal for final hearing in seriatim.

(Sujit Narayan Prasad, J.) (Navneet Kumar, J.) R.Kumar /
